fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Entry Group ID
fields.help: The id of the entry group this entry link is in.

fields.label: Entry Link ID
fields.help: The id of the entry link to create.

fields.label: Entry Link Type
fields.help: Relative resource name of the Entry Link Type used to create this Entry Link.

fields.label: Aspects
Aspect Key
fields.help: The map keys of the Aspects which the service should modify.

fields.label: Data
fields.help: The content of the aspect in JSON form, according to its aspect type schema.
The Aspects attached to the Entry Link.

fields.label: Entry References
Name
fields.help: The relative resource name of the referenced Entry, of the form: projects/{project_id_or_number}/locations/{location_id}/entryGroups/{entry_group_id}/entries/{entry_id}

fields.label: Path
fields.help: The path in the Entry that is referenced in the Entry Link.

fields.label: Type
fields.help: The reference type of the Entry.
Specifies the Entries referenced in the Entry Link.
